goal: Find a small frequent net-profitable perpetual sleeve for the original same-account objective; core sleeve remains unqualified
data_partition: The next registered main forward capture is discovery screening. Later nonoverlapping forward capture is required for validation. Pilot prices are source checks only; no pilot outcome tuning.

ReceivedBookAbsorption.past_return: Most recent already received valid book at decision and30seconds earlier, each within1second; no interpolation

common_filters.feature_decision: UTC minute boundary, last feature row at or before boundary and no older than1second; only received information
common_filters.per_candidate_proposals: At most1proposal perminute across six symbols and both directions; highest abs(flow30)*abs(flow120), then symbol ascending
common_filters.control_common_population: Same all12factor-complete population, not flow-only coverage advantage

quote_labels.entry: First valid observed book at least1000ms after minute decision, at most another1000ms later; buy ask/sell bid
quote_labels.trigger: First observed executable-side quote crossing price threshold; exit uses first valid observed book at least1000ms after trigger and within another1000ms
quote_labels.time_exit: First valid observed book at least1800seconds after entry and within1000ms; preserve unknown if unavailable
quote_labels.price: Long opens at ask and closes at bid; short opens at bid and closes at ask; no touch-equals-fill, maker rebate or price-barrier fill assumption
quote_labels.funding: Verify actual funding history over exact capture bounds after completion; missing or incomplete source is unknown, never assumed zero. At settlements use contemporaneous observed mid proxy and disclose it.
quote_labels.maturity: Exclude decisions whose fixed worst-case entry, holding and exit buffer extend beyond capture end; never include tail rows because future exits happened early
quote_labels.source_gaps: Any observed connection break, invalid quote or event-age violation affecting the path makes the label unknown; no filling or offline backfill into live features

limitations: Quote labels cannot prove actual exchange fills, maker queue position, contract rounding, full-account risk or leaderboard rank. Screening can reject, but cannot qualify production.
